title: Language-model embeddings and ML prioritize immunomodulatory medicinal plants
summary: Medicinal plant data encoded with pre-trained language models were used to train classifiers; logistic regression on BiomedBERT embeddings reached an F1-score of 0.787 in cross-validation and, on a held-out test set (n = 37), accuracy 0.757 and AUC 0.835. Three of four external validation plants were classified correctly, and selected plants were tested in vitro for iNOS and inflammatory cytokine gene modulation. Test and validation sets are small.
ai_technology: Logistic regression on BiomedBERT embeddings of literature-derived plant data
organization: Biochemistry, Biotechnology and Immunophysiopathology Research Team, Ain Chock Faculty of Sciences, Hassan II University of Casablanca, Morocco

evidence.tested: Held-out and external plant classification plus in vitro assays of iNOS and cytokine genes for selected plants.
evidence.unknown: Which compounds drive the effects and any in vivo or clinical relevance; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A language-model-based classifier ranked plants for predicted immunomodulatory activity.
